CLEAR-DEVICE
Clears  selected adaptor and SCSI bus.
DECODE
A numeric value is decoded according to specified format.
LIST-PRESENT-DEVICES
Parameters for the connected SCSI adaptors and devices are printed.
LIST-DEFINED-DEVICES
Defined devices are printed.
SELECT-DEVICE
Selects device to operate on. Use logical device name if running SINTRAN.
Use SCSI adaptor and SCSI id if running stand-alone (SINTRAN is not running).
RUN-ADAPTOR-TESTS
This command runs the host adaptor tests in a default sequence or
as specified by operator.
Tests:
1. Registers write/read back
2. Control/Status
3. DMA in test mode
4. Interrupt at level 11
5. NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status

 NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status
RUN-DEVICE-TESTS
This command runs device tests for the selected device
in a default sequence or as specified by the operator.
Tests:
 1. Drive contact
 2. Basic drive self test
 3. Extended drive self test 
 4. SCSI bus data transport
 5. SCSI bus stress
10. Seek min/max
11. Random seek
12. Write/read scratch
13. Random read
14. Random read data partition - write scratch
20. Write/read magtape
21. BOT test
22. Wear test
23. Filemark test
30. Write/read streamer
31. Over/under run
32. Filemark/space test
40. Write to optical
41. Read/test optical
SET-PARAMETERS
This command allows the operator to define how the program should
execute its "RUN" sections.
CREATE-OPTICAL-TEST-DISK
Creates a optical test disk.
SET-OPTICAL-DISK-PARAMETERS
Changes the default parameters for the 'write to optical' test and
the 'Read/test optical' test.
TAPE-SERVICES
Services: REWIND, LOAD, UNLOAD
SET-TAPE-PARAMETERS
Change the default parameters for the write/read magtape and
write/read streamer tests.
DUMP-SENSE-DATA
Sense information for the last error message.
PRINT-TAPE-STATISTICS
Prints the statistic data which are collected while running the 
magtape/streamer tests.
SET-BUFFER-LIMITS
The operator may set first and last memory page for the
DMA buffer.Mg:-

Test for ND-100/110 SCSI adaptor,  SCSI bus and  connected devices.
CLEAR-DEVICE
Clears  selected adaptor and SCSI bus.
DECODE
A numeric value is decoded according to specified format.
LIST-PRESENT-DEVICES
Parameters for the connected SCSI adaptors and devices are printed.
LIST-DEFINED-DEVICES
Defined devices are printed.
SELECT-DEVICE
Selects device to operate on. Use logical device name if running SINTRAN.
Use SCSI adaptor and SCSI id if running stand-alone (SINTRAN is not running).
RUN-ADAPTOR-TESTS
This command runs the host adaptor tests in a default sequence or
as specified by operator.
Tests:
1. Registers write/read back
2. Control/Status
3. DMA in test mode
4. Interrupt at level 11
5. NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status
RUN-DEVICE-TESTS
This command runs device tests for the selected device
in a default sequence or as specified by the operator.
Tests:
 1. Drive contact
 2. Basic drive self test
 3. Extended drive self test 
 4. SCSI bus data transport
 5. SCSI bus stress
10. Seek min/max
11. Random seek
12. Write/read scratch
13. Random read
14. Random read data partition - write scratch
20. Write/read magtape
21. BOT test
22. Wear test
23. Filemark test
30. Write/read streamer
31. Over/under run
32. Filemark/space test
40. Write to optical
41. Read/test optical
SET-PARAMETERS
This command allows the operator to define how the program should
execute its "RUN" sections.
CREATE-OPTICAL-TEST-DISK
Creates a optical test disk.
SET-OPTICAL-DISK-PARAMETERS
Changes the default parameters for the 'write to optical' test and
the 'Read/test optical' test.
TAPE-SERVICES
Services: REWIND, LOAD, UNLOAD
SET-TAPE-PARAMETERS
Change the default parameters for the write/read magtape and
write/read streamer tests.

CREATE-OPTICAL-TEST-DISK
Creates a optical test disk.
SET-OPTICAL-DISK-PARAMETERS
Changes the default parameters for the 'write to optical' test and
the 'Read/test optical' test.
TAPE-SERVICES
Services: REWIND, LOAD, UNLOAD
SET-TAPE-PARAMETERS
Change the default parameters for the write/read magtape and
write/read streamer tests.
DUMP-SENSE-DATA
Sense information for the last error message.
PRINT-TAPE-STATISTICS
Prints the statistic data which are collected while running the 
magtape/streamer tests.

Test for ND-100/110 SCSI adaptor,  SCSI bus and  connected devices.
CLEAR-DEVICE
Clears  selected adaptor and SCSI bus.
DECODE
A numeric value is decoded according to specified format.
LIST-PRESENT-DEVICES
Parameters for the connected SCSI adaptors and devices are printed.
LIST-DEFINED-DEVICES
Defined devices are printed.
SELECT-DEVICE
Selects device to operate on. Use logical device name if running SINTRAN.
Use SCSI adaptor and SCSI id if running stand-alone (SINTRAN is not running).
RUN-ADAPTOR-TESTS
This command runs the host adaptor tests in a default sequence or
as specified by operator.
Tests:
1. Registers write/read back
2. Control/Status
3. DMA in test mode
4. Interrupt at level 11
5. NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status
RUN-DEVICE-TESTS
This command runs device tests for the selected device
in a default sequence or as specified by the operator.
Tests:
 1. Drive contact
 2. Basic drive self test
 3. Extended drive self test 
 4. SCSI bus data transport
 5. SCSI bus stress
10. Seek min/max
11. Random seek
12. Write/read scratch
13. Random read
14. Random read data partition - write scratch
20. Write/read magtape
21. BOT test
22. Wear test
23. Filemark test
30. Write/read streamer
31. Over/under run
32. Filemark/space test
40. Write to optical
41. Read/test optical

Test for ND-100/110 SCSI adaptor,  SCSI bus and  connected devices.
CLEAR-DEVICE;Z
Clears  selected adaptor and SCSI bus.;q
DECODE;w
A numeric value is decoded according to specified format.
LIST-PRESENT-DEVICES;%
Parameters for the connected SCSI adaptors and devices are printed.
LIST-DEFINED-DEVICES;X
Defined devices are printed.;j
SELECT-DEVICE
Selects device to operate on. Use logical device name if running SINTRAN.
Use SCSI adaptor and SCSI id if running stand-alone (SINTRAN is not running).<D
RUN-ADAPTOR-TESTS
This command runs the host adaptor tests in a default sequence or
as specified by operator.
Tests:
1. Registers write/read back
2. Control/Status
3. DMA in test mode
4. Interrupt at level 11
5. NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status<Z
RUN-DEVICE-TESTS<e
This command runs device tests for the selected device
in a default sequence or as specified by the operator.
Tests:
 1. Drive contact
 2. Basic drive self test
 3. Extended drive self test 
 4. SCSI bus data transport
 5. SCSI bus stress
10. Seek min/max
11. Random seek
12. Write/read scratch
13. Random read
14. Random read data partition - write scratch
20. Write/read magtape
21. BOT test
22. Wear test
23. Filemark test
30. Write/read streamer
31. Over/under run
32. Filemark/space test
40. Write to optical
41. Read/test optical>
SET-PARAMETERS>
This command allows the operator to define how the program should
execute its "RUN" sections.>>
CREATE-OPTICAL-TEST-DISK>M
Creates a optical test disk.>_
SET-OPTICAL-DISK-PARAMETERS
Changes the default parameters for the 'write to optical' test and
the 'Read/test optical' test.
TAPE-SERVICES
Services: REWIND, LOAD, UNLOAD>B
SET-TAPE-PARAMETERS
Change the default parameters for the write/read magtape and
write/read streamer tests.>

EVICES
Defined devices are printed.
SELECT-DEVICE
Selects device to operate on. Use logical device name if running SINTRAN.
Use SCSI adaptor and SCSI id if running stand-alone (SINTRAN is not running).
RUN-ADAPTOR-TESTS
This command runs the host adaptor tests in a default sequence or
as specified by operator.
Tests:
1. Registers write/read back
2. Control/Status
3. DMA in test mode
4. Interrupt at level 11
5. NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status
RUN-DEVICE-TESTS
This command runs device tests for the selected device
in a default sequence or as specified by the operator.
Tests:
 1. Drive contact
 2. Basic drive self test
 3. Extended drive self test 
 4. SCSI bus data transport
 5. SCSI bus stress
10. Seek min/max
11. Random seek
12. Write/read scratch
13. Random read
14. Random read data partition - write scratch
20. Write/read magtape
21. BOT test
22. Wear test
23. Filemark test
30. Write/read streamer
31. Over/under run
32. Filemark/space test
40. Write to optical
41. Read/test optical
SET-PARAMETERS
This command allows the operator to define how the program should
execute its "RUN" sections.
CREATE-OPTICAL-TEST-DISK
Creates a optical test disk.
SET-OPTICAL-DISK-PARAMETERS
Changes the default parameters for the 'write to optical' test and
the 'Read/test optical' test.
TAPE-SERVICES
Services: REWIND, LOAD, UNLOAD
SET-TAPE-PARAMETERS
Change the default parameters for the write/read magtape and
write/read streamer tests.
DUMP-SENSE-DATA
Sense information for the last error message.
PRINT-TAPE-STATISTICS
Prints the statistic data which are collected while running the 
magtape/streamer tests.
SET-BUFFER-LIMITS

%  Domino states                                           %
%                                                          %
%      0 = Unknown state                                   %
%      1 = Not in table       (no devices defined)         %
%      2 = Not Scsi hardware                               %
%      3 = Aborted            (error detected)             %
%      4 = Stopped                                         %
%      5 = Initializing                                    %
%      6 = Partly available   (Errors in initialization)   %
%      7 = Available                                       %

   Routine Void, Integer2 ( tscDevice ) : FindUnitdataField ( Dev )
   %-------------------------------------------------------%
      Integer  : Idx
      %----------------------------------------------------%
      For Idx In UnitDataField Do
      While Dev.scDevDataField >< UnitDataField(Idx).DevData
      ExitWhile
         UnitDataField(Idx).UnitData Return
      ExitFor
         0 Return
      EndFor
   EndRoutine

   %--------------------------------------------------------%
   Routine Void, tscStatus ( tscDevice, tpbMemory ) : SCSI03h ( Dev, Memory )
   %--------------------------------------------------------%
      Constant  ReqSense = 03b
      Bytes   : Cmnd(0:11)
   %--------------------------------------------------------%
      If Dev scDevEqual scSenDevice Then
         pbPhMove(scStatusBuffer,0,Memory,0,-1)
         scSenStatus Return
      Else
         0               =: Cmnd
         ReqSense        =: Cmnd(0)
         Dev scByte1     =: Cmnd(1)
         scAllLen Memory =: Cmnd(4)
         Dev scCommand ( Memory, Cmnd ) Return
      EndIf
   EndRoutine

Do you want suppression of error messages ?

s and  connected devices.
CLEAR-DEVICE
Clears  selected adaptor and SCSI bus.
DECODE
A numeric value is decoded according to specified format.
LIST-PRESENT-DEVICES
Parameters for the connected SCSI adaptors and devices are printed.
LIST-DEFINED-DEVICES
Defined devices are printed.
SELECT-DEVICE
Selects device to operate on. Use logical device name if running SINTRAN.
Use SCSI adaptor and SCSI id if running stand-alone (SINTRAN is not running).
RUN-ADAPTOR-TESTS
This command runs the host adaptor tests in a default sequence or
as specified by operator.
Tests:
1. Registers write/read back
2. Control/Status
3. DMA in test mode
4. Interrupt at level 11
5. NCR chip self diagnostic test
6. NCR chip SCSI commands/status
RUN-DEVICE-TESTS
This command runs device tests for the selected device
in a default sequence or as specified by the operator.
Tests:
 1. Drive contact
 2. Basic drive self test
 3. Extended drive self test 
 4. SCSI bus data transport
 5. SCSI bus stress
10. Seek min/max
11. Random seek
12. Write/read scratch
13. Random read
14. Random read data partition - write scratch
20. Write/read magtape
21. BOT test
22. Wear test
23. Filemark test
30. Write/read streamer
31. Over/under run
32. Filemark/space test
40. Write to optical
41. Read/test optical
SET-PARAMETERS
This command allows the operator to define how the program should
execute its "RUN" sections.
CREATE-OPTICAL-TEST-DISK
Creates a optical test disk.
SET-OPTICAL-DISK-PARAMETERS
Changes the default parameters for the 'write to optical' test and
the 'Read/test optical' test.
TAPE-SERVICES
Services: REWIND, LOAD, UNLOAD
SET-TAPE-PARAMETERS
Change the default parameters for the write/read magtape and
write/read streamer tests.
DUMP-SENSE-DATA
Sense information for the last error message.
PRINT-TAPE-STATISTICS
Prints the statistic dat'eSsi

ADDRESS-INPUT-RADIX
"Address input radix ...............
Octal
Decimal
Hexadecimal
Binary
FIRST-PHYSICAL-BUFFER-PAGE
First physical buffer page ..
First page in physical memory for DMA buffers.
LAST-PHYSICAL-BUFFER-PAGE
Last physical buffer page ...
Last page in physical memory for DMA buffers.
	SCSI-TRACE
SCSI command tracer.
REASSIGN <Media address>
Relocates one locical media block.
REFRESH-DATA <Media address>
The selected sector is read and then written back. This is
to cure temporary perity errors.
Media address
Logical medium addess for operation
LIST-DISK-INFORMATION
Various static and dynamic information conserning the selected
disk is printed.
LIST-REFRESH-TABLE
All sectors refreshed since the last formatting done is printed.
LIST-REASSIGN-TABLE
All sectors reassigned since the last formatting done is printed.
,CONVERT-DISK-ADDRESS <Address type> <Address>
Convert disk addresses from different input modes and
print it in all modes (Media, Locial-SINTRAN and Page)
Address
Address in selected mode to convert.
Address type
Media
Logical-SINTRAN
Page
LIST-PARAMETERS
Lists the current parameters set by the commmand "SET-PARAMETERS".
The selected adaptor does not respond to the hardware device number
defined for it. Either you have wrong thomb weel setting or an
error in the adaptor.
If a ID number is not present and you have a connected drive
with that ID number, it could be several reasons for this:
  1 : The cable is not correct connected to disk drive.
  2 : The disk drive is dead.
  3 : The disk drive is not ready after power up.
  4 : The disk drive is not ready after a bus reset due to
      too short timeout after reset (see "SET-PARAMETERS").
The selected device has a disk that is not delivered from Norsk Data
or i use. If this command is not used,
other commands will automaticaly prompt for device if needed.
After a sucsessful selection, the device is reserved. Release
of the device is done with the "EXIT" command or when a new
device is seleced sucessfully.
Use "?" when prompted, for further details.
Adaptor ..............
Legal answers are adaptor name (ADAPTOR-n, n=1:4), adaptor
number (1:4), logical device number or hardware device
number for adaptor.
ID Number
Give the SCSI ID number for the disk drive you want to use.
Range 0:7 (7 is normaly the host adaptors ID number).
ID number 0 (adaptor 1) is normaly equivalent to "DISC-SCSI-1".
	INITIALIZE
Creates the partition block on the disk and allocates data, format,
mirror, table, test data and scratch areas. This has to be done
before SINTRAN can use the disk and before datatests in
test program can be done on scratch area.
FORMAT-INITIALIZE (<Options>)
Formats the entire disk and initializes the disk
(see the command "INITIALIZE").
* NB * All information on the disk will be lost.
Format options
Clear-Groth-List
No-More-Options
VERIFY <From> <To>
This command will read and verify the partition block and
verify a user specified area of the disk.
From (Media address)
Give the first media address for verification
To   (Media address)
Give the last media address for verification
!SET-PARAMETERS <parameter> <value>
Set parameters for exeution of device operations or
program functions.
Parameter name 
ALL-PARAMETERS
BUS-RESET
Allow SCSI bus reset ..
A SCSI bus reset will abort all other traffic on the bus. An
initial reset is nessesary when running stand alone and no other
host adaptors are connected to the bus.
RESET-TIMEOUT
SCSI bus reset timeout (sec.)
This is the time in seconds to wait after a SCSI bus reset
for the SCSI devices on the bus to compleate their sefteL]u
